commercial_product.note: Fresenius is primarily a healthcare services and medical-device conglomerate. Major commercial franchises: Fresenius Medical Care (dialysis services and devices including 2008T, 5008, NxStage hemodialysis systems), Fresenius Kabi (IV generics, clinical nutrition, transfusion technology, biosimilars including Idacio/adalimumab, Stimufend/pegfilgrastim, Tyenne/tocilizumab, Conexxence/denosumab), and Fresenius Helios (hospital operations).

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Catumaxomab ovarian cancer Phase 2 - COMPLETED long ago; Removab withdrawn from market in 2017
MSB11455 PK/PD healthy volunteer study - COMPLETED; pegfilgrastim biosimilar now approved as Stimufend

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated trial (Assistance Publique - Hopitaux de Paris) of tocilizumab in CPPD; Fresenius Kabi makes biosimilar tocilizumab but is not the sponsor and asset is not Fresenius proprietary
Investigator-initiated FORCE Trial (Anna Arthur, PhD); Fresenius Kabi only supplies nutrition product, not the asset owner
Investigator-initiated antibiotic absorption study (Central Hospital Nancy); Fresenius Kabi supplies generic antibiotics but is not the asset owner

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diversified healthcare conglomerate (dialysis services/devices, hospital operations, IV generics, biosimilars). Limited proprietary clinical pipeline; biosimilars program develops molecules off existing reference products without large public Phase 1-3 trials. The two listed assets are a pivotal CRRT-procedure study and a pediatric label-extension for already-approved difelikefalin.
